name: Meal Planner
description: A weekly meal planner for a space. Collaborators lay out breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks across a seven-day week, step between weeks, drag meals between days, and keep servings and notes on each. When a Recipe Box is in the same space, each day gets a recipe picker over its recipes, and a week's ingredients go to the space's Grocery List in one click (re-sending never duplicates what is still on the list). Everyone else, including anyone the frame is published to, sees the plan live and read-only. The plan is the meal_plan table in the space's frame data folder (_fdata/meal_plan.table.jsonl); recipes and groceries are the recipes and grocery tables beside it, shared by name with those frames.
